two_phase_summary.scope_note: Checked against every registry raster whose bytes are present locally (plus any explicitly fetched witnesses). Un-fetched registry entries are a stated scope limitation, never a claim of absence.

literal_reading.note: Keeps the inherited literal support definition. A continuous-surface prior fires on every nonempty candidate, so a firing here is not evidence of duplication; it is reported for completeness.

like_for_like_reading.note: Inherited thresholds, applied to dot fields only; rank correlation still applies to every raster including the continuous surfaces.

literal_all_rasters_audit.note: Space-filling priors may make the literal gate impossible for many candidate dot sets; they are nevertheless binding under the requested rule and must not be silently exempted.

discriminating_dot_fields_gate.z2_lattice_theorem: 13gems_20261001_r13-lattice-s5 places dots on every (5i, 5j) lattice node across Nevada; since max_{y,x in Z} sqrt(min_i(y-5i)^2 + min_j(x-5j)^2) = sqrt(2^2 + 2^2) = sqrt(8) = 2.8284 < 3.0 px, 99.87% of all allowed pixels in Z^2 lie <= 3 px from r13-lattice-s5 (classified as `space_filling` by `vendor/gems57/uniqueness.py::representation_class_v2`).
